messages:
sam: Hey — planning to run an A/B experiment in Console: model-v2 (prod) vs model-v3 (canary). Want canary + auto-guard that pauses if latency p95 > 800ms or errors > 2%. Also need a per-variant token budget so we don't suddenly blow costs. How do folks usually express the routing rules/guards and quota in the Console/rollouts API?

maria: we have the rollouts UX where you create an experiment, add variants and weights, and attach guards. The console UI exposes a few templates (latency, errors). Quotas per-variant aren't first-class in the old UI though.

li: fwiw console guards currently understand infra metrics (latency.p95, errors.rate, gpu.mem). For token budgets you'll need a budget config on the rollout config (API only today) or a separate quota policy.

nina: we added predicate support for variants — you can scope by headers, routes, api_key, or do deterministic sampling via hash. For a small canary do: `hash(request.user_id) % 100 < 5` to get ~5% users.

jonah: also think about quality signals — console won't natively detect semantic regressions. Emit custom telemetry events for answer-quality and wire them into the experiment dashboards.

sam: can you paste a minimal example JSON for the rollout API? would help me bootstrap.

nina: sure — quick example (API payload):

```json
{
  "experiment_id": "exp-canary-model-v3",
  "description": "Canary v3 vs v2: 5% traffic to v3 then ramp",
  "variants": [
    {"name": "v2", "weight": 95},
    {"name": "v3", "weight": 5, "predicate": "hash(user.id) % 100 < 5"}
  ],
  "guards": [
    {"metric": "latency.p95", "op": ">", "value": 800, "action": "pause"},
    {"metric": "errors.rate", "op": ">", "value": 2, "action": "rollback"}
  ],
  "variant_budget": {"v3": {"tokens_per_minute": 20000}},
  "telemetry_flags": ["rollout.exposure", "rollout.outcome", "model.quality"]
}
```

li: that looks good. Note: `variant_budget` is enforced by the routing proxy which stops forwarding to a variant when the token cap is hit — currently best-effort, not hard guarantee.

sam: what about cost accounting? model-v3 is quantized but still more expensive per token. We should show an estimated delta in the Console UI during setup.

maria: agreed — UX request: add `cost_estimate_per_1000_tokens` on each variant so PMs see the probable spend. Will follow up with a tiny mock.

jonah: for routing by user groups (internal beta) you can do `request.header.x-internal == 'true'` or add a `user_group` array to the experiment and Console will allow target selection. Example predicate: `request.header.x-beta == \"true\"`

sam: telemetry — do I need to flip any flags to see experiment metrics in the Console dashboard?

jonah: you need to emit the `rollout.exposure` events (variant, user_hash, timestamp, token_count) and `rollout.result` events (variant, metrics like latency, answer_quality). We have a schema in the analytics repo. Console will consume those if `telemetry_flags` is enabled on the experiment.

deploybot: deploybot: canary experiment created by sam — experiment_id=exp-canary-model-v3, rollout_id=r_2024_11_01_03, created_at=1742106795

nina: action items: I'll add a short docs snippet + Postman collection for the API. @li can you add predicate helper snippets in the SDK? @jonah please add the telemetry event templates to analytics repo. @maria can you prototype cost delta mock for the UI?

sam: I'll create the experiment and kick it off with a 5% canary. Will report back after 30m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
